'''Kickback''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]]. Kickback served under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of "[[Blue Four/Legends|Blue Four]]" in [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], a Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] led by [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Blue Squadron participated in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], to destroy [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk's]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] over the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

During the battle, Kickback accompanied fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Axe (clone trooper)/Legends|Axe]], [[Slammer/Legends|Slammer]], [[Tucker/Legends|Tucker]], and [[Group Two/Legends|Group Two]] leader [[Swoop (clone trooper)/Legends|Swoop]], while the squadron made their way toward Tuuk's [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Ryloth)|command ship]]. However, Confederate [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] attacked Blue Squadron, causing heavy damage to several of their fighters. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Yularen]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ordered Tano and her men to retreat; however, several of Blue Squadron's fighters have been shot down in the ongoing [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, crippling Tano's squadron. Tano, and two out of the ten fighters that accompanied her, safely boarded the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], before it jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

==Biography==
After [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] seized control of the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and its [[Twi'lek/Legends|inhabitants]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] dispatched [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to destroy the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] blockade surrounding the planet, under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]]. Ahsoka led a squadron, for the first time, taking command of [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] under the callsign [[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]]. Kickback joined fellow pilots [[Axe (clone trooper)/Legends|Axe]], [[Slammer/Legends|Slammer]], [[Tucker/Legends|Tucker]] and [[Swoop (clone trooper)/Legends|Swoop]] in his [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] in fighting the advancing [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], and his squadron was able to cut a clear path to the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|lead ship]]. However, after Separatists reinforcements arrived out of hyperspace, Ahsoka disobeyed a direct order from both [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Yularen]] and Anakin to return and defend the ''Resolute''. [[Tucker/Legends|Tucker]] was shot down by a Vulture droid. Ahsoka finally complied, but by the time she returned to the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], eight of her original ten clone pilots had died. Kickback and Swoop being the only two survivors.<ref name="tcwce">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A clone trooper pilot with armor identical to Kickback's appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|web comic]] [[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part III)|''Hunting the Hunters, Part III'']], but so far has not been identified as him.
